title: REST spec: add list and load function endpoints
summary: huaxingao called a vote on adding two read-only REST catalog endpoints following the Iceberg UDF spec: GET /v1/{prefix}/namespaces/{namespace}/functions to list functions in a namespace and GET .../functions/{function} to load one. The load result returns inline UDF metadata and an optional metadata-location, following the load table and load view pattern; create, update and delete endpoints are to follow in a separate proposal. The original vote in March listed FunctionIdentifier objects in the list response. On June 1 huaxingao restarted the vote after the FunctionIdentifier versus CatalogObjectIdentifier question was resolved: PR 16144 merged CatalogObjectIdentifier and spec PR 15180 now uses it. szehon-ho voted +1 and suggested that tracking a specific-name in addition to definition-id would let engines refer to each overload, as a general addition to the function spec. The vote passed and huaxingao said she would merge the spec change.

positions.stance: Add read-only list and load function endpoints to the REST spec, modeled on the table and view endpoints, with CRUD endpoints proposed separately.
Supports the endpoints; suggests the function spec track a specific-name besides definition-id so engines can reference each overloaded version.

outcome.note: Passed with 10 +1 votes (5 binding), no -1 and no +0. The spec change in PR 15180 is to be merged.

why_it_matters: REST catalogs gain standard endpoints for listing and loading UDFs, the first function support in the REST spec.
